Statewide parcels with owner and mailing address verified (2.6M records). Projects: CDOT 10-Year Plan lines/points verified (phase and type, no cost or dates); CDOT's fuller 'Projects (all types)' server was unreachable and is unverified.

CTDOT Project Work Areas polygons cover planning through completed projects (phase, cost, advertising date; no work-type field), and the CT GIS Office statewide CAMA and Parcel layer has owner and mailing address under CC0.

DelDOT CTP project layers on FirstMap carry phase, cost and estimated/actual milestone dates (including real-estate dates). Both needs are met statewide: FDOT's adopted five-year work program with a right-of-way phase, and statewide parcels with owner name and mailing address. The work program layer is per phase and its URL changes each program year.

Projects work: MaineDOT's advertise plan gives this year's lettings as lines and points with scope, estimate and advertise date, and an all-projects polygon layer has a Planned/Candidate status. Parcels are partial: a state layer has owner and mailing address for roughly 211 of the organized towns via a joined table; other towns have boundaries only and data age varies. County-level sources were not researched because Maine parcels are kept by towns, not counties.

MDOT SHA project portal points (status, work type, estimated start) and the FY2026-2031 CTP points verify; both are point-only and lack cost. The statewide MD iMAP parcel layer (https://mdgeodata.md.gov/imap/rest/services/PlanningCadastre/MD_ParcelBoundaries/MapServer/0, 2,293,824 parcels, verified) has owner MAILING address (OWNADD1, OWNADD2, OWNCITY, OWNSTATE, OWNERZIP), ACCTID, ADDRESS, NFMTTLVL, ACRES and an SDAT link (SDATWEBADR) but NO owner-name field. Owner names verified for Prince George's, Anne Arundel and Baltimore City; Montgomery County's layer (gis3.montgomerycountymd.gov .../property/property_query/MapServer/0) also has owner address but no name, and Baltimore County's server was unreachable.
MassDOT Highway/CIP and TIP project line layers verify with status and scheduled advertising date, and MassGIS statewide parcels include owner name and mailing address.

Projects: MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program 2027-2031 lines and points verified, with work type, budget, STIP status and scheduled let dates. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; verified Detroit (Wayne), Macomb and Genesee; Oakland, Kent and the rest of Wayne not available free.

MnDOT's 10-year plan gives planned projects as lines (roads) and points (bridges) but cost is a text range and there is no letting date, only fiscal year. Parcels with owner names exist for 60 of 87 counties in one MnGeo layer (all the big metro counties except Scott have owners); the other 27 counties are missing.

Parcels are covered statewide with owner name and mailing address (official MARIS service, no paging support). No planned-projects GIS source was found: MDOT publishes only under-construction and completed projects on a non-GIS map.
